title: EvaluatingSyntheticTS
summary: A research codebase that trains and evaluates multiple synthetic time series generators (RNN-VAE, TimeGAN, cBetaVAE, and SDV-based models) on UCR Archive datasets, comparing utility via downstream classification accuracy. It uses SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN) as baseline generators trained and sampled through the sdv.single_table API with Metadata objects.
evidence: Generators/train_ctgan.py:1-3 uses CTGANSynthesizer, Metadata, Condition from sdv; utility_evaluator.py loads CopulaGAN/TVAE/CTGAN synthesizers
